path.description: File, directory, or supported image path to read.

workdir.description: Optional absolute directory used to resolve a relative local path. It is never inherited from another call, a session default, cwd, or home directory. Omit it for kkstudio: resources or absolute local paths. Provide an expanded absolute path (no '~' or environment-variable placeholders); Windows targets use a drive-rooted or UNC path.

offset.description: Positive integer 1-based line offset for text reads. Defaults to 1.

limit.description: Positive integer maximum number of text lines to return. Defaults to 200 and must not exceed 2000. When column_offset is specified, limit defaults to 1 and must equal 1.

column_offset.description: Optional positive integer 1-based offset in Unicode code points within the selected text line. Text files only. When specified, limit defaults to 1 and must equal 1.
